concept: Ecology and Functions of an ecosystem
question: What are endemic species?

options.text: Exotic animals brought from other countries
Species found only in a particular area and nowhere else

solution:
The correct answer is __**Species found only in a particular area and nowhere else**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Endemic species are **organisms that are native to and found exclusively in a particular geographical region**. They are not found naturally anywhere else in the world.
 
• These species evolve and adapt to the specific environmental conditions of their habitat over time. Their survival is closely linked to the health and stability of the ecosystem they belong to.
 
• The presence of endemic species is often an indicator of a region's unique biodiversity and ecological significance.
 
• Examples of endemic species include the **Nilgiri Tahr** found in the Western Ghats of India, the Galápagos torto
